management_notes: CEO Tasheel Jeerh (effective May 5, 2026) delivered on the Spring 2026 commitment: 23 drillholes and 4,267m at Pomley Cove Pond and Frost Cove North, with headline assays released August 29, 2026. The simultaneous launch of the 5,000m Taylor Brook program, backed by a closed $2,600,000 placement, demonstrates sequential capital market access across multiple NL property targets. Score of 3 maintained: execution risk on the Spring 2026 program has resolved and capital allocation across multiple fronts is disciplined. Constraining factors remain: insider ownership levels and the CEO's broader track record prior to Churchill are unconfirmable from public sources; management depth below the CEO/IR level is thin for a multi-property district explorer. No new management-related disclosures since the August 29 assay release.
geology_notes: Spring 2026 assay results released August 29, 2026 — four days old as of this scorecard date. Headline intercept confirmed: 19.23% Sb over 1.40m at Frost Cove North from a 23-hole, 4,267m program at Pomley Cove Pond and Frost Cove North. A copper-silver discovery returned 0.78% Cu with 6.12 g/t Ag over 6.22m, broadening the polymetallic thesis beyond the core antimony-gold story. Cumulative confirmed highlights across the Black Raven district: (1) 19.23% Sb over 1.40m at Frost Cove North (Spring 2026); (2) 35.1% and 29.7% Sb at Black Raven past-producers; (3) 13.00% Sb over 0.57m at Frost Cove (May 2026); (4) 9.46% Sb with 35.5 g/t Au and 1,118 g/t Ag discovered 1.2km north of the historic mine; (5) 7.25% Sb over 1.98m at a second polymetallic system near the southern shaft; (6) 17.3 g/t Au and 130 g/t Ag at Pomley Cove Pond veins; (7) up to 12.11% Zn grab samples at Black Raven; (8) Taylors Room: 10.59 g/t AuEq over 1.05m and 4.12 g/t AuEq over 1.80m; (9) new Cu-Ag intercept 0.78% Cu / 6.12 g/t Ag over 6.22m. TSXV approval for the Golden Baie antimony-gold option (announced March 2026) adds a fourth property to the district-scale portfolio. The August 2023 NI 43-101 technical report remains the most recent on file; all resource/reserve fields are null per the extracted filings. The 5,000m Taylor Brook program is active with no assays released yet. Score of 3 maintained: confirmed high-grade, multi-commodity mineralisation across an expanding NL district, constrained by the absence of a compliant resource estimate and the early stage of Taylor Brook.

catalyst_notes: Spring 2026 assay results released August 29, 2026 — now four days old as of September 2. The market has absorbed the 19.23% Sb / 1.40m headline and the new Cu-Ag system (0.78% Cu / 6.12 g/t Ag / 6.22m) through three trading sessions (August 29 and the week of September 1). No further news released since August 29. The active 5,000m Taylor Brook drill program represents the next significant catalyst window; first assay results from Taylor Brook are expected in coming months. The new Cu-Ag discovery could generate independent follow-up drilling as a third catalyst stream beyond Taylor Brook and further Black Raven extensions. Golden Baie (TSXV-approved option, March 2026) may provide an additional catalyst through planned 2026 trenching and geophysics. Macro: China's September 2024 antimony export controls remain in force; US DoD critical minerals grant programs have awarded over USD $100M to Tier-1 jurisdiction antimony projects since late 2025, sustaining strategic buyer attention. Score of 3 maintained: primary catalyst fired positively; Taylor Brook and Cu-Ag follow-up open fresh catalyst windows; macro tailwind is durable.

Score of 2 maintained: strategic conditions are favourable but the absence of a compliant resource prevents a quantified acquisition discount analysis.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources (CRI.V) holds the Foxtrot past-producing antimony mine district in central Newfoundland and is advancing a multi-property, multi-commodity explorer position (Black Raven/Frost Cove, Golden Baie, Taylor Brook, Pomley Cove Pond, Taylors Room). STATUS as of September 2, 2026: Spring 2026 assay results were released August 29 (four days ago). The Spring 2026 program totalled 23 drillholes and 4,267m at Pomley Cove Pond and Frost Cove North. Headline intercept: 19.23% Sb over 1.40m at Frost Cove North. A new copper-silver prospect returned 0.78% Cu with 6.12 g/t Ag over 6.22m, broadening the polymetallic thesis beyond antimony-gold. No further news released since August 29. The active 5,000m Taylor Brook drill program is the next primary catalyst; first assay results expected in coming months. TSXV-approved Golden Baie option (March 2026) adds a fourth property and additional 2026 exploration catalyst potential. Macro tailwind intact: China's antimony export controls remain in force; US DoD has awarded over USD $100M to Tier-1 jurisdiction antimony projects since late 2025. Cap table per April 2026 MD&A extraction (most recent reliable data): 316,681,940 shares issued, 342,756,940 fully diluted (2,625,000 warrants + 23,450,000 options — strike prices and expiry dates not extracted). Post-April 2026 placements (the $2.6M Taylor Brook financing) likely push shares outstanding to approximately 354M–390M+ — not captured in the extracted data. No NI 43-101 compliant resource on file; all resource/reserve fields are null. Maintain WATCH, confidence low: the resolved assay catalyst and new Cu-Ag intercept improve the geological thesis, and the active Taylor Brook program is a genuine near-term catalyst; however, the absence of a compliant resource, heavy and growing share structure, and unconfirmed full scope of post-April dilution limit conviction. Taylor Brook first-assay results are the primary forward catalyst.
